TC-01/S26.detail: Hospital H1-H3 + an age-72 no-sex patient, NH N1/N3/N4 + a no-unit resident, pairwise-distinct values (final2). Per card: own name, room/unit, badge and Hospital diagnosis present; no neighbour value on any card; no invented sex or room; no undefined/null/NaN. Fails: (1) no card shows a hospital day (Hospital) or visit number (Nursing Home) - 14 card readings; (2) Q1-dependent: every card shows age as '76y', never '76F' - but the app has no way to enter sex (no sex input anywhere in src/; the schema field roundingFields.sex / snfFields.sex was written only by this test's API seed), so these 11 cells wait for Q1 (where sex comes from), as the matrix oracle says; (3) Q4-dependent: every Nursing Home card shows its stored diagnosis - 10 cells, judged per TC-03 while Q4 is open.
TC-01/S26.productIssue: On the home list no card shows the hospital day (Hospital) or visit number (Nursing Home), so a patient on hospital day 6 or a resident on a 5th visit looks the same as one added today. Breaks UAT TC-01 Expected Result ('the hospital day or visit number') and TFA-92579 AC 3. Q1-dependent, not a rendering-only bug: the card shows 'Room 412 · 76y', not '76F', and there is no way to enter sex in the app. Q4-dependent: Nursing Home cards show the stored diagnosis, which TC-03 says the NH card must not show.
